description.narrative: The Project will enhance climate smart agriculture development and practices focused on strengthening Low Carbong Agriculture (LCA) policies and institutions; establishing infrastructure support for agri-waste management; and, enhancing LCA technology and development transfer. These will be parts of climate change (CC) mitigation and adaptation measures to reduce green house gas (GHG) emission in 19 provinces of Viet Nam.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Greater uptake of Climate Smart Agricultural Waste Management Practices (CSAWMP)

At least 70% bio-slurry is converted to organic fertilizers Progress/Status: Substantially Achieved - Physical audit in 2017-18 indicated that 58% (equivalent to 83% of target) of treated effluent from biogas plants was applied as fertilizer. Data Source: PPMS and Biogas users' survey Actual value:

At least 80% energy produced by biogas value chains (BVCs) is utilized Progress/Status: Substantially Achieved - Utilization of SBP gas was greater and approached 90% as the scale of gas production better matched individual household. Utilization of digester gas was limited for MSP and LSP compared with volumes of gas produced. requirements. Data Source: PPMS and Biogas users' survey Actual value:

Daily workload of women and children is reduced by 1.8-2 hours, on average Progress/Status: Achieved - Baseline survey indicated biogas digesters save an average of 0.76 hour for cooking; 0.84 hour for preparing feed; 0.66 hour for feeding livestock and 0.59 hour for cleaning facilities. On a daily basis, total working time on cooking and taking care of livestock is reduced by 2.85 hours. Data Source: PPMS and Biogas users' survey Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 1. Expanded Use of Livestock Waste Management Infrastructure Indicator: 1.2. ICMD funds are fully channeled into at least 65,042 accounts of beneficiaries by June 2019 Progress/Status: Achieved - ICMD funds are fully channeled into 62,333 accounts of beneficiaries. Data Source: PPMS Actual value:

Output: 1. Expanded Use of Livestock Waste Management Infrastructure Indicator: 1.3. 65,000 SBP operators, 500 masons, 500 technicians, 28 engineers and 10 contractors trained by June 2019. At least 50% of trainees on biogas use will be women; 7% of trainees on SBP construction, and 20% of those trained on biogas management and technical issues will be women. Progress/Status: Achieved - 117,447 SBP operators, 346 masons, 1,286 technicians, 28 engineers and 18 contractors trained. 52.7% (61,872) of trainees on biogas use are women. 7% (29) of trainees on SBP construction, and 23.4% (300) of trainees on biogas management and technical issues are women. Data Source: PPMS Actual value:

Output: 1. Expanded Use of Livestock Waste Management Infrastructure Indicator: From baselines in 2013: 1.1. 65,000 SBPs, 40 MBPs and 2 LBPs and associated value chain infrastructure constructed and operating by June 2019. At least 5% of total SBPs will be constructed for ethnic minorities in project provinces. Progress/Status: Achieved - A total of 62.248 SBVCs, 83 MBPs and 02 LBPs have been constructed by livestock farming HH of which 6,581 SBPs (10.6%) are constructed for ethnic minorities in 5 selected provinces. (Son La: 1.892 SBPs, Bac Giang: 968 SBPs, Soc Trang: 1.170 SBPs, Lao Cai: 2.008 SBPs, Phu Tho: 496 SBPs) Data Source: PPMS Actual value:

Output: 2. Credit Lines for Biogas Value Chains and other climate smart agriculture waste management investments Indicator: 2.1 50% of credit lines will be under joint accounts and/or on behalf of women by June 2019. Progress/Status: Achieved - of the 457 sub-loans extended by FIs, 100% were issued in joint names. Data Source: PPMS Actual value:

Output: 2. Credit Lines for Biogas Value Chains and other climate smart agriculture waste management investments Indicator: 2.3. At least 15,000 households raising livestock have accessed credits for BVC and other climate smart agriculture waste management investments from the participating Financial Intermediaries by June 2019. Progress/Status: Not achieved - A total of 457 household sub-loans were extended by FIs in five provinces prior to the cancellation of the credit facility in 2018. Data Source: PPMS Actual value:

Output: 3. Enhanced Climate Smart Agriculture Waste Management Practices (CSAWMP) technology transfer Indicator: 3.1 CSAWMP research strategy developed and adaptive research on at least 6 CSAWMP topics conducted by June 2019. At least 2 research topics will include gender issues. Progress/Status: Partially Achieved - Consultants were engaged to propose a research strategy for government and propose adaptive research identifying seven research topics. These were ratified by MARD in 2020 as appropriate technologies. Seven research packages were awarded, three of which achieved intended research targets (Nos. 27, 29 and 42). The remaining four packages (Nos. 25, 26, 28 and 43) failed to deliver expected outputs. Data Source: PPMS Actual value:

Output: 3. Enhanced Climate Smart Agriculture Waste Management Practices (CSAWMP) technology transfer Indicator: 3.2 At least 7 CSAWMP models are successfully demonstrated and disseminated in 10 participating provinces by June 2019. Progress/Status: Achieved - Twelve demonstration packages (including five replication packages) were undertaken on 189 households of the 10 provinces. Data Source: PPMS Actual value:

Output: 3. Enhanced Climate Smart Agriculture Waste Management Practices (CSAWMP) technology transfer Indicator: 3.3 At least 7,000 farmers, 700 extension staff, and 200 researchers trained on CSAMWPs by June 2019. At least 50% of farmers and 30% of extension staff trained are women. Progress/Status: Achieved - The project provided CSAWMP training to 26,538 farmers - (50.5% being women) and 1,739 extension workers (33.2% being women). Data Source: PPMS Actual value:

Output: 1. Expanded Use of Livestock Waste Management Infrastructure Indicator: 1.4. Single national biogas plant database managed effectively by 2017, including registration in both husband's and wife's names. Progress/Status: Not Achieved - 47,640 biogas plants were recorded in the LCASP database (not a national database) by project completion yet only 14,178 of those qualified for participation in an international carbon credit scheme. Majority of recorded BPs did not register in both husband's and wife's names. Data Source: PPMS Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Target year: 2017 Target value: Y

Output: 4. Effective project management Indicator: 4.1. A CPMU and 10 PPMUs established and operational with adequately skilled staff and facilities in MARD by first quarter of 2013. At least 30% of staff are women and a gender focal point will be appointed by 2014. Progress/Status: Achieved - A CPMU and 10 PPMUs established in second quarter of 2013. Data Source: PPMS Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Target year: 2014 Target value: Y

Output: 4. Effective project management Indicator: 4.2. PPMS with sex-disaggregated and ethnicity data collected and reported operating effectively in 10 provinces by 2015. Progress/Status: Achieved - as of June 2020, 56 of 129 staff were women - 43.41%. Gender focal points in CPMU and PPMUs were appointed in July 2016. Data Source: PPMS Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2012 Baseline value: N Target year: 2015 Target value: Y
